system.description: You picture the tether between the body and soul of a foe within 30', and snap it.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the foe is Stupefied for d4 rounds instead.
outcomes.success: The foe takes d12 damage. Its body acts on without will: it is Stupefied until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.ruin: Your own tether frays: you are Stupefied until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
